auditTitle: Patroner M00 Pre-Gate Auth-2 Artifact Hash & Content Integrity Verification

artifacts.jsonContentSummary: Verifies 7 entities (CoordinateFrameSpec, BezierSegment, SeamAllowanceSpec, NotchSpec, OffsetClassificationReport, BodyProfile, PatternPiece) between JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 and Pydantic v2.
discrepanciesAgainstSubmittedReportsAndA: Submitted chat summary claimed entities verified were (BodyProfile, GarmentSpec, PatternPiece, Notch, SeamAllowance, DxfExportManifest, GeometryWarning); actual JSON verifies (CoordinateFrameSpec, BezierSegment, SeamAllowanceSpec, NotchSpec, OffsetClassificationReport, BodyProfile, PatternPiece).
Omits ADR-009 §2.5 NumericalVerificationRecord and ADR-009 §5.3 OffsetValidationRecord schemas.

artifacts.jsonContentSummary: Captures C0-Legacy counts across 6 sizes (XS..XXL) for bodice and skirt blocks, sample armscye length/offset metrics, and 4 divergence entries (DIV-01 Class A; DIV-02, DIV-03, DIV-04 Class B).
discrepanciesAgainstSubmittedReportsAndA: Captures only high-level piece/seam/notch counts across XS..XXL and one sample armscye curve diagnostic rather than full coordinate/DXF geometry snapshots across all blocks.

artifacts.jsonContentSummary: Evaluates 3 candidate stacks: (1) mpmath.iv 1.4.1 + fractions.Fraction (2.4142 ms/curve), (2) python-flint 0.9.0 (0.024 ms/curve), (3) fractions.Fraction + decimal.Decimal prec=50 (0.1662 ms/curve). Records boolean flags outwardDirectedRoundingVerified=true, grazingTangencyNoFalseNegative=true, wilkinsonClusterSeparationVerified=true.
discrepanciesAgainstSubmittedReportsAndA: CONFLICTING CHAT WIDTHS RESOLVED: Submitted Chat Report A claimed widths (2.86e-16, 4.44e-16, 2.00e-50); Submitted Chat Report B claimed widths (2.13e-16, 3.70e-16, 2.00e-50). Actual IntervalLibraryQualificationReport.json contains NO width fields at all (only boolean outwardDirectedRoundingVerified: true).

Actual computed widths in qualification.py for c = 1/3 + 1/7 are: mpmath.iv (prec=53) = 1.110223e-16, mpmath.iv (prec=113) = 9.629650e-35; flint.arb (prec=113) diameter = 1.444447e-34 (at prec=53 diameter = 1.665335e-16, sqrt(2) diameter = 4.440892e-16); DecimalInterval (prec=50) c width = 2.00e-50, sqrt(2) width = 1.00e-49.

Does not satisfy ADR-009 §3.2 8-point qualification protocol (tested 1 rational pair instead of 10,000; tested 1 sqrt instead of 10,000; compared mpmath.iv against 256-bit mpmath.mpf instead of fractions.Fraction; flint.arb used .overlaps() instead of strict containment; embeds wall-clock timing making artifact non-deterministic across runs).

artifacts.jsonContentSummary: Records 17 test family entries (AG-01..AG-17) generated by execute_17_adversarial_geometry_families() in services/geometry-engine/patroner_geometry/c1_cert_oracle.py.
discrepanciesAgainstSubmittedReportsAndA: Submitted Chat Report A and Submitted Chat Report B both contradict the actual JSON contents on AG-01, AG-02, AG-03, AG-04, AG-05, AG-06, AG-08, AG-10, AG-12, AG-14, AG-15, AG-16, and AG-17.
AG-02 (CCW Circle s=+1, d=10=R collapse) is classified as TANGENTIAL_CUSP_DEGENERACY in JSON instead of ADR-009 §4.2 Case 2 ACTUAL_OFFSET_SINGULARITY / ACTUAL_ZERO_SPEED_CUSP.

AG-03 (CCW Circle s=+1, d=12>R=10 over-offset) is classified as ACTUAL_CURVATURE_CUSP in JSON, directly violating ADR-009 §4.2 Case 3 & §6 #3 which require TANGENT_REVERSAL with has_zero_speed_cusp_on_domain=false.
Multiple family entries (AG-01..AG-05, AG-14, AG-15, AG-17) rely on hardcoded error metrics or point evaluations rather than complete-interval [0, 1] Bernstein/interval enclosures.

artifacts.jsonContentSummary: Compares 5-point adaptive Gauss-Legendre arc length (16.6656505146 cm, 23 panels) against 113-bit mpmath.quad (forwardLengthErrorCm = 1.4210854715202004e-14 cm) and checks Newton-Brent inversion at 25%, 50%, 75%.
discrepanciesAgainstSubmittedReportsAndA: Submitted chat reports claimed 'forward error 0.0 cm <= 1e-6 cm' and '16-node Gauss-Legendre + 24-node adaptive Simpson on AG-13'; actual JSON tests 5-point Gauss-Legendre on 'bodice-front-armscye-m005' with forwardLengthErrorCm = 1.4210854715202004e-14 cm.
Uses mpmath.quad (HIGH_PRECISION_NUMERICAL_REFERENCE) instead of ADR-009 §2.4 Method C1-Cert adaptive De Casteljau chord/control-polygon enclosure (CERTIFIED_ENCLOSURE).

artifacts.jsonContentSummary: Verifies exact rational orient2d and shoelace signed area on 4 synthetic polygons: CCW exterior (1008.0 cm^2), CW cutout (-25.0 cm^2), bowtie self-intersection, and micro-sliver (< 1e-4 cm^2).
discrepanciesAgainstSubmittedReportsAndA: segments_properly_intersect_exact in sub_oracles.py:239 checks only strict proper crossings (o1*o2 < 0 and o3*o4 < 0) and does not handle collinear overlapping segments or vertex-on-edge intersections (orient2d == 0).

artifacts.jsonContentSummary: Recovers layers ['1', '11', '2', '4', '7', '8'] with maxVertexRoundTripErrorCm = 0.0 cm from a synthetic ENTITIES-only DXF string emitted by emit_reference_dxf_aama().
discrepanciesAgainstSubmittedReportsAndA: Does not test round-trip against the application's actual DXF exporter (src/engine/export/) and omits DXF R12 (AC1009) HEADER and TABLES sections.

artifacts.jsonContentSummary: Validates 3 golden BodyProfiles (STD-XS, STD-M, PLUS-XXL), rejects 1 invalid profile (lowHipCm=80 < highHipCm=96 - 2), and checks 3 hardcoded seam-pair deltas against DEC-11 (0.05 cm CAD / 0.20 cm sewn).
discrepanciesAgainstSubmittedReportsAndA: Submitted Chat Report A claimed rejection was for 'chest_cm < bust_arc_half_cm * 2'; actual code in contracts.py:133 rejects 'lowHipCm < highHipCm - 2.0'.
DEC-11 paired seam values in sub_oracles.py:524-528 are static hardcoded numbers rather than computed from drafted pattern pieces.

artifacts.jsonContentSummary: Records Checkpoint 12 governance metadata, Python 3.10.12 environment, pinned package versions, and SHA-256 digests of the other 8 artifacts.
discrepanciesAgainstSubmittedReportsAndA: Records Python 3.10.12 (container system Python) whereas M00.3 / ADR-009 §3.2 specify Python 3.12.x with uv.lock.

Claims deterministicReplayVerified: true, but scripts/m00_execute_all.py:117 only replays execute_17_adversarial_geometry_families(), whereas generate_interval_library_qualification_report() embeds live time.perf_counter() latency measurements.
